title: Doubly exponential convergence of the cyclic steepest descent method for strictly convex quadratics in arbitrary dimensions
summary: We study the cyclic steepest descent method (CSD) for strictly convex quadratic minimization. CSD repeats, for j consecutive iterations, the exact steepest-descent step size computed at the beginning of each cycle. The only rigorous result for the real algorithm has so far been restricted to two dimensions, where the cycle-starting gradient sequence is known to converge doubly exponentially.
